name: builder
summary: Fluent, step-by-step constructor for a complex object, validated before build().
description: Creates a builder class with a fluent interface that constructs and validates a product object
problem: An object has many parameters — most optional, easy to pass in the wrong order — and cramming them into one constructor call is unreadable. You want to assemble it step by step through named, chainable methods, validate the accumulated state, and only then construct the immutable product.
appliesWhen: The object has multiple optional parts that vary per use
Construction happens in stages or across call sites before the object is complete
You want named, fluent setters instead of long positional argument lists
The final state needs validation before the object may exist
avoidWhen: The object has only a couple of required parameters — call the constructor directly
You're converting existing raw data into a model in one shot — that's a factory
You'd allow mutating the product after build() — that defeats the pattern; keep products immutable
Every consumer builds the same fixed shape — a factory method or director-style helper is simpler
examples: Add an email builder with to, cc, subject, and body steps
I need a fluent way to assemble a report definition
Constructing this query object takes too many constructor args
Create a builder that validates before constructing the Order
tradeoffs: One file. Clearer call sites and validated construction, but it's over-engineering for simple objects — reach for it only when optional parameters and staged construction genuinely exist. Keep the product immutable.
outputs: A {name} builder class with a build() method returning {model}
A validate() hook invoked before construction
postApply: Add a state property and a fluent setter (returning $this) for each configurable part
Provide sensible defaults for optional parts
Implement validate() to throw InvalidArgumentException when required state is missing
Keep the product immutable — all mutation happens in the builder, none after build()

model.aiHint: Use the FQCN of the product (usually a model created by phpnomad/model). The product should be immutable.
